annotations.text:
FIRST SCREEN

Fin gets a habitat, not a chip: the water is drawn into the panel and the mascot sits in it, bleeding off the right edge. The copy column is capped at 58% so it can never collide with the art.

Greeting, term, timeline and the three headline numbers are ONE panel divided by hairlines — not five floating cards.

DARK

Canvas #12132b, surfaces #1b1d3a / #262a4d — the same indigo-navy family as the welcome screen's #1a1f3d card, so entering the app is not a change of world. The gap between layers is what stops it reading as a void.

FULL SCROLL

Sections are colour-coded by domain: indigo schedule, amber tasks, emerald events, violet subjects. Task and event rows use sample data — this term currently has none.
Attendance reads 22% → "At risk" in red. That is the real number from the current term, not a styling choice: the tile picks its tint from the value (≥90 emerald, ≥75 amber, below red).

The rules the screens are built from. Three things to hold onto: the neutrals are COOL and faintly indigo, matching the login hero — no cast shadows anywhere, depth is a tonal step plus a 2px bottom lip — and saturated colour is reserved for state (active attendance, NOW, overdue, risk).
